description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to intestate property in Waradala, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510001 & Other Properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - it contains notices calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) under the Registration of Title Act. The content includes detailed land descriptions, parcel numbers, cadastral maps, and procedures for registering title to land properties. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration, property ownership transfers, and title settlement matters.
